name: Alertmanager Matrix
description: Receive Alertmanager webhooks through a JWT-authenticated gateway entry. Envoy Gateway verifies the EC-signed token, removes the Authorization header before n8n creates the execution, and forwards only the sub claim; the workflow requires that claim and forbids any surviving Authorization header. Raw annotations are never rendered: the message is built from a fixed template with strictly validated values, so credential-shaped text cannot reach Matrix. Execution data persistence is disabled.
